title: Language as the Interface: Foundation-Model Contrastive Learning Links Transcriptomes and Electrophysiology
abstract: arXiv:2609.37024v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Integrating transcriptomic and electrophysiological data is essential for building multimodal foundation models for neuroscience. Patch-seq provides paired measurements of gene expression and intrinsic electrophysiology from the same neuron, establishing a basis for training cross-modal models. Here we introduce LangPatch, a foundation-model-based contrastive learning framework that uses paired Patch-seq data to align pretrained GenePT representations with electrophysiological phenotypes through a language-based interface. Gene descriptions and verbalized electrophysiological profiles are embedded by the same frozen text encoder. A context adapter and projection modules connect the modalities through paired contrastive learning. translated_title: 语言作为接口：基础模型对比学习连接转录组与电生理学
translated_abstract: 整合转录组学与电生理学数据对于构建神经科学的多模态基础模型至关重要。Patch-seq技术能够从同一神经元获得基因表达和内在电生理特性的配对测量，为训练跨模态模型奠定了基础。本文提出了LangPatch，一个基于基础模型的对比学习框架，利用配对的Patch-seq数据，通过基于语言的接口将预训练的GenePT表示与电生理表型进行对齐。基因描述和语言化表达的电生理特征由同一个冻结的文本编码器进行嵌入，上下文适配器和投影模块通过配对对比学习连接两个模态。在小鼠视觉皮层、小鼠运动皮层和人类皮层数据集中，LangPatch在所有被评估的基础模型和表示学习方法中实现了最高的转录组到电生理预测平均相关性。
tldr: LangPatch框架通过将基因描述与电生理特征映射到同一语言空间并进行配对对比学习，成功将预训练基因基础模型GenePT与Patch-seq电生理表型对齐，在多个小鼠和人类皮层数据集上取得了最优的转录组到电生理预测性能。
en_tdlr: LangPatch is a foundation-model contrastive learning framework that aligns pretrained GenePT transcriptomic representations with electrophysiological phenotypes through a shared language-based interface, achieving state-of-the-art transcriptome-to-electrophysiology prediction across mouse visual, mouse motor, and human cortical cohorts.
